title: Parking on the sidewalk
question: Can I park my car on the sidewalk in Poland?
short_answer: Sometimes allowed, but only under strict conditions.
conditions: A minimum 1.5 m walkway must remain clear for pedestrians
Vehicle must weigh no more than 2.5 tonnes
Allowed only in zones marked with sign P-20 or D-18a
Parking must be parallel to the road
exceptions: Emergency vehicles may always park on sidewalks
Vehicles with disabled parking permit (karta parkingowa) may park on sidewalks
penalties: Fine: 100 PLN for illegal sidewalk parking
Vehicle may be towed at owner's expense
Towing cost: 500–700 PLN depending on city

sources.title: Prawo o ruchu drogowym – Sejm RP
